result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy `embeddable_hosts` values verbatim (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's `before_validation` stripping of `http://` and paths. The new lookup `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches only via `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so migrated values like the old spec fixtures 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' would never match, breaking previously-allowed embeds after upgrade; string interpolation also invites SQL breakage. The mechanism is fully visible in the diff.
